nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same person shown in the reference image. A Spanish man in his mid-20s, olive skin, short-cropped dark hair, lean labour-hardened build, in a dust-covered cotton work shirt and drill trousers, one foot wrapped in grimy gauze. He sits on the step of a company house, resting the bandaged foot on the tailings-covered yard. Spanish people with olive to fair Mediterranean skin, dark brown to black hair and brown eyes. 1962 Wittenoom company house of corrugated iron and asbestos-cement sheeting, yard surfaced with blue-grey tailings, red earth beyond. Low late-afternoon sun, the house's long shadow crossing the yard. Medium shot, slightly high angle, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph taken in 1962, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
